item.title: Global antisemitism up 34% after Iran war outbreak
item.description: Jew-hatred surged in the week after war against the Islamic Republic began, with half tied directly to the conflict, new CAM data show. The post Global antisemitism up 34% after Iran war outbreak appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: Who will take the uranium?
item.description: The fate of Iran’s stockpile of highly enriched uranium—enough, if weaponized, for multiple nuclear bombs—may determine whether the current campaign against Tehran’s nuclear ambitions succeeds. The post Who will take the uranium? appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: Meet the Israeli woman breaking barriers in space
item.description: “Recent regional events highlight that space is an integral part of our national security infrastructure,” Dr. Shimrit Tirosh Maman, head of the Israel Space Agency, told JNS. The post Meet the Israeli woman breaking barriers in space appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: UAV operator tells JNS about missions ‘some did not think possible’

item.title: Hezbollah, judging war with Israel inevitable, stockpiled for months

item.title: Seventh US service member dies from Iranian attacks
item.description: The service member was critically wounded in a March 1 attack on U.S. forces in Saudi Arabia and died from those injuries Sunday night, CENTCOM said. The post Seventh US service member dies from Iranian attacks appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: Witkoff, Kushner expected to meet Netanyahu in Jerusalem
item.description: The visit would be the first by senior U.S. officials to Israel since the Feb. 28 launch of "Operation Roaring Lion/Epic Fury," the joint military campaign against the Islamic Republic. The post Witkoff, Kushner expected to meet Netanyahu in Jerusalem appeared first on JNS.org.
